description: The Mocana Cryptographic Module is the cryptographic engine of Mocana’s TrustCore development platform. The trust and crypto abstraction layers reduce costs with extensibility across secure elements, a modular architecture for H/W acceleration and plugins to comply with export/import controls. For details see www.digicert.com
